cycle.label: Registration period
cycle.note: Registration runs from the 1st of the month after your birth month to the last day of your birth month two years later.

requirements.label: Classroom or live interactive webinar
requirements.note: At least 16 hours in a classroom or live interactive webinar (or as a lecturer). We count courses marked Group Live or Group Internet Based — set the delivery method on each course.

requirements.label: Accounting, auditing, tax, business law or consulting
Accounting, auditing or tax
requirements.note: At least 16 of the 40 in accounting, auditing or taxation.

requirements.label: Computer
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 20 hours of computer courses count per registration period.

requirements.label: Ethics (AICPA Code + Arizona Board rules)
requirements.note: 4 hours, including at least 1 hour on the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and 1 hour on Arizona Board statutes and rules. Not taught by your employer or a co-worker. We count courses with "Arizona" and "ethics" in the title — edit the title if yours isn't picked up.

newLicensee.note: Registration period shorter than two years: hours are prorated by quarter (ethics isn't)

licenseDateHint: Arizona registrations end on the last day of your birth month every two years (e.g. 03/31/2028).
issueDateHint: If your first registration period is shorter than two years, hours are prorated by quarter from this date.
limitsNotTracked: Authorship: max 20 hours; instruction plus authorship: max 40 hours.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for three years.
toVerify: First-period proration: quarters counted from the issue date to the end of the period, part quarters rounded up (the rule just says 'prorated by quarter').
Group Internet Based counted as 'interactive live webinar' — self-study, nano and blended don't count toward the 16 live hours.
'Computer courses' mapped to NASBA Computer Software and Applications only (not Information Technology).
Whether Arizona-approved ethics hours also count toward the 40 core hours (we don't count them).
